summary: Inspected the entire two-file Schaapcommon diff, both complete regression tests, scripts/test.sh integration, requirements, prior review-threaded-v2.json and surrounding production paths. No blocking defect found. Under reject-before-accept semantics, callback-construction and submission failures count down unaccepted jobs, drain accepted workers and bare-rethrow the original exception, including when draining workers throw. Shared callback, scheduler and partial-helper lifetimes remain valid; exception publication is synchronized and reuse is covered. Canonical bucket sorting precedes subdivision, channel scanning establishes tile/minplane containment, and caller-ordered merging limits live tile helpers to 32. Nonfinite guards and uninstrumented repeats remain. Inspected saved passing normal/ASan/UBSan/TSan scheduler logs and the 597-check gridder log; did not execute regression or heavy tests. Executed shell-syntax and diff-whitespace checks successfully. This is code approval only: full suites remain with the parent, and the initial 4K old/new T2 failure remains recorded and unwaived.
